name: Odin
one_line: The agent harness GT products build on: sessions, tool calling, streaming and skills as a managed service.
try_in_5: Open the dev UI, start a session and ask it something.

name: Trudax
one_line: An AI business-intelligence assistant that gives clear, grounded answers from your Power BI dashboards in minutes.
try_in_5: Ask it a question about a dashboard you already know the answer to.

name: SpatialQ
one_line: A no-code, AI-powered platform that turns complex earth and geospatial data into answers, by conversation instead of GIS workflows.
try_in_5: Ask it for schools near an LRT station.

name: Agentlinc
one_line: A centralised knowledge platform that connects to the organisation's data sources and helps draft, summarise and research.
try_in_5: Ask it to summarise a policy document you already know.

name: GT-Console
one_line: The shared backend and admin console behind GT products: tenants, users, access and quotas in one place.
try_in_5: Find your own tenant and look at who has access.
